subject: deadline mix-up
text:
Sorry, this may be messy, but I'm trying to sort out the timeline before I get too far ahead. I thought the revised slides were due Thursday at noon, but then I saw a note saying internal review could start earlier, which made me think maybe the draft needs to be in your hands by tomorrow night. I checked my notes and the date I wrote down is Wednesday, yet the folder metadata says something else. I'm not trying to be difficult, just anxious about missing the real moment when it stops being a draft and becomes something we can't quietly fix afterward.

The print vendor just emailed saying the color proofs move up to tomorrow morning. If that is true, then maybe the internal deadline actually was yesterday? I know, that would be silly, but I'm getting tangled.

Also, did the request for the smaller chart version replace the longer summary, or should I do both? I started the second version, but if the client only wants one, I'll stop and shift focus. There's also the invoice question. I know it's not urgent, but if the deliverable moves up, will the payment terms move with it? I'm not asking now if it's too much, just trying to plan.

If there is a firm cutoff this week, please give it as simply as possible, even just the time zone. If not, I can work from my current assumption. I'll send a confirmation afterward so we're aligned.
